messages.author: dadcb4fd6a01f8d1
messages.subject: Re: [brainGraph-help] BrainGraph for fmri analysis
parts: Yes. Depending on the package/software you use to create the connectivity matrices, the code to get the data into R will be a little different. I have succeeded in getting in matrices from DPARSF/DPABI and can share code if that's what you are using. And I can come up with solutions for other software given the example data & directory structure.
